title: Best Paper Awards in Computer Science (since 1996)
abstract: This is a list of best paper awards for conferences in the field of computer science. It includes all conferences that I found results for, but is not complete. It started in 2010 and has been updated annually as more award-winning papers are found. Please contact me if you know of other awards that aren't yet listed.
summary: The webpage 'Best Paper Awards in Computer Science (since 1996)' is a resource compiled by Jeff Huang that catalogs best paper awards from various computer science conferences from 1996 onwards. The document is not a research paper in the traditional sense but a comprehensive list, continuously updated with new awards and conferences. The list serves as a reference for understanding trends in quality research and recognizes significant contributions across multiple areas in computer science. Due to its nature as a list and archive, it does not have direct academic citations typical of influential research papers. However, it functions as an informational resource for researchers, students, and academics interested in the history and recognition of impactful work in the field. Therefore, no specific citations of the list itself influencing other research or industry practices have been documented.
